title: EXP-019-R2 — Clean Replay: Fresh-Dialog Classic Wizard Selection
objective: Independently replay the EXP-019 visible wizard-selection procedure in User scope. First establish that the inherited EXP-019 first Build-from-Scratch wizard page is still unfilled and has produced no artifact; cancel that page through its visible Cancel control as preflight cleanup only. Then open one fresh Form Wizard Selection dialog through Web Designer New Form Definition, select Category Classic through its rendered dropdown option, select Build from Scratch / Plain form without defined components through its rendered dropdown option, type nothing into either dropdown, and submit the selection dialog exactly once. Verify that the first Build-from-Scratch wizard page appears again, then stop before entering a name, advancing, finishing, saving, or creating any artifact. A successful replay may promote only the complete visible selection sequence to replay_verified; it must not attribute success to reopening, Category selection, Wizard reselection, or any internal mechanism individually. Saving, close/reopen persistence, and artifact durability are not applicable because this replay intentionally stops before Form creation.

in_scope: Read the EXP-019 record and the verified basic-form recipe before browser interaction
Inspect the inherited Designer state, User editing scope, loaded-form identity, clean/dirty state, and the currently open first Build-from-Scratch wizard page
Only if the inherited wizard page visibly has an empty Name and no partially created artifact or dirty-state prompt, cancel that page through its visible Cancel control as preflight cleanup
Verify that no creation wizard or selection dialog remains after cleanup before starting the replay
Open Form Wizard Selection once through the supported Web Designer New Form Definition path with New Form selected
Capture the freshly opened dialog before changing either dropdown
Open the rendered Category dropdown and select the rendered Classic option without typing
Capture both the rendered Classic option before selection and the visibly selected Category state afterward
Open the rendered Wizard dropdown and select the rendered Build from Scratch / Plain form without defined components option without typing
Capture both the rendered Build from Scratch option before selection and the visibly selected Wizard state afterward
Click the Form Wizard Selection OK button at most once
Capture decisive visible evidence that the first Form Wizard - Build From Scratch page appeared with Name still empty
Write only the EXP-019-R2 experiment record and evidence files
out_of_scope: Continuation or replay of EXP-018 Button Caption recovery
Entering a Form name or creating any Form artifact
Saving, regenerating, closing/reopening, or persistence testing of a Form
Testing which individual action caused EXP-019 to succeed
FormSync, Output=View semantics, generated SQL, or metadata export
Components, events, scripts, IDOs, portals, bindings, or runtime behavior
Changing editing scope, preferences, environment, authentication, application instance, or model configuration
Hidden controls, internal stores, framework internals, direct SQL, internal APIs, or reverse-engineered requests

prohibited_actions: Creating, modifying or deleting any non-FX_ artifact
Starting any other experiment or replay
Modifying production data or disabling security
Do not proceed if the inherited first wizard page contains any entered Name, unexpected mutation, dirty-state prompt, permission prompt, or evidence of a partially created artifact
Do not type Classic, BuildFromScratch, Build from Scratch, or any guessed internal key into either dropdown field
Do not use JavaScript evaluation, Ext component/store access, hidden or off-screen controls, synthetic events, internal APIs, direct SQL, or reverse-engineered requests
Do not enter a Form name
Do not click Next or Finish
Do not Save or Regenerate a Form or template
Do not create, modify, delete, or complete any Mongoose artifact
Do not reload, navigate directly to another URL, restart the browser/backend, sign out, or reauthenticate to recover
Do not dismiss or bypass any unexpected alert, dirty-state prompt, permission request, or partially completed wizard
Do not submit the Form Wizard Selection dialog more than once
Do not try an alternate selection strategy if the replay fails
Do not attribute success or failure to any single constituent action; the fresh-dialog recreation and untyped two-dropdown sequence remain coupled
Do not classify the procedure as replay_verified unless the first Build-from-Scratch page visibly appears in this independent replay before any name entry or advancement

acceptance_checks.description: Preflight evidence visibly establishes a live Designer session in User scope, identifies the inherited EXP-019 first Build-from-Scratch wizard page, shows its Name field still empty and no dirty/partial-artifact state, then shows that page cancelled through its visible Cancel control with no creation wizard or selection dialog remaining. Any unexpected mutation, prompt, expired session requiring recovery, or inability to establish these facts blocks the replay.

Evidence identifies a newly opened Form Wizard Selection dialog with initially uncommitted selections and separately captures the rendered Classic option before its native selection plus the visible selected Category state afterward, then the rendered Build from Scratch / Plain form without defined components option before its native selection plus the visible selected Wizard state afterward. The record states the native interaction used for each and confirms that neither dropdown received typed input; selected textbox text alone is insufficient.

After exactly one Form Wizard Selection OK submission, decisive visible evidence identifies the first Form Wizard - Build From Scratch page with the Name field still empty and before any Next, Finish, Save, or artifact creation. A rejection alert, ambiguous page, second submission requirement, or inability to identify the page fails this check and blocks the replay.

The EXP-019-R2 record lists the exact replay sequence, evidence paths, final UI state, and any errors; confirms no Form name entry, Next/Finish/Save/Regenerate, artifact creation, authentication recovery, alternate selection strategy, or second submission occurred; and explicitly states that a successful replay verifies only repeatability of the complete fresh-dialog plus untyped two-dropdown selection sequence. It must retain as unresolved which constituent action was decisive relative to EXP-018 and must exclude persistence, Form creation, internal-cause, and single-variable causal claims.

notes: Proposed by the coordinator after run R-20261005-212205-UYB7. Rationale: EXP-019 produced a successful single-attempt observation for the combined fresh-dialog plus untyped rendered-option sequence, but it is not replay-verified. The smallest useful next step is an independent clean replay of that exact semantic procedure rather than returning to the blocked EXP-018 Button Caption experiment or widening into Form creation. This follows the project's observed-to-replay-verified progression while preserving the explicit limitation that dialog recreation and the two native selections remain a coupled procedure whose individual causal effects cannot be distinguished.
